subject: Security & deployment follow-up — ACME private VPC options
messages:

Subject: Security & deployment follow-up — ACME private VPC options

Hi Jordan — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side:

- We heard that ACME needs a private/VPC deployment with network isolation and support for strict data residency (US).
- Primary compliance drivers: SOC 2 (Type II in progress), GDPR scoping for EU data flows, and potential HIPAA controls for a pilot with health customer sets.
- ACME asked about air-gapped/on-prem options and what the Redwood Private offering looks like (network diagram, KMS integration, audit logs).

Next steps:
1) I attached a high-level deployment diagram showing a Private VPC topology (redwood-private-vpc-arch.png).
2) I included a vendor security questionnaire template to kick off your security team (vendor-security-questionnaire-acme.xlsx).
3) Neha will follow up on SOC 2 artifacts we can reasonably share and our HIPAA posture.
4) Can we schedule a 30 min follow-up next week (Wed or Thu) with your security and infra leads to walk the diagram and the questionnaire?

If you prefer, I can also include our solutions engineer for the network deep-dive.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood-private-vpc-arch.png (PNG, 420 KB), vendor-security-questionnaire-acme.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet)

Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security & deployment follow-up — ACME private VPC options

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the clear recap. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- SOC 2: we will want to see the most recent SOC 2 report and management response. Can you confirm the expected delivery timeline for those artifacts and whether there are any redactions?
- GDPR: we need details on data residency controls and whether logs or backups ever leave our designated region.
- HIPAA: the pilot scope is small at first, but we need confirmation on BAAs and encryption at rest and in transit.
- Air-gapped: our security lead is particularly interested in whether Redwood supports fully air-gapped deployments (no egress) and what the upgrade/patch process looks like in that scenario.

I'll coordinate with our Security Team on availability for a follow-up next Wed/Thu afternoon PST. In the meantime can you send any existing SOC 2 artifacts and a brief note on the upgrade/patch process for air-gapped deployments?

Jordan
Jordan Ellis
Director, Cloud Infrastructure | ACME Corp
jordan.ellis@acme.com | +1 (617) 555-4821

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Security Team <security@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 11:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security & deployment follow-up — ACME private VPC options

Jordan — quick update from our side and answers to your questions below.

- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II in 2024; we are currently in the next audit cycle (2026) and can provide the 2024 report under NDA with limited redactions for third-party vendor details. Neha, looping you for artifact sharing process.
- GDPR/Data residency: In Private/VPC mode, customer data storage and backups can be restricted to the chosen cloud region. Our default retention and logging policies are configurable and we offer options to disable cross-region backups. We'll include the configuration knobs in the follow-up doc.
- HIPAA/BAA: We do offer BAA for customers requiring HIPAA compliance. The BAA and required technical controls (encryption at rest with KMS integration, TLS for transit, IAM scoping) are standard for Private deployments.
- Air-gapped/on-prem: We support an on-prem package that can be deployed in isolated networks. Patching/upgrades in air-gapped mode are performed via signed bundle delivery and an operator-run upgrade process; we provide a documented checklist and can run a workshop with your infra team. Note that certain telemetry/managed control-plane features are disabled in air-gapped mode.

Attachments: vendor-security-questionnaire-acme.xlsx (updated with responses column)

Can you confirm the names/emails of the infra/security folks who should receive the questionnaire? Also proposing Wed, 7 Jul 2026 at 10:00 AM PST for a 30-minute tech sync (I can include our solutions engineer). Does that work?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
